roles.title: Salesforce Administrator / Developer
roles.description: I administer and develop the CRM that supports internal banking workflows and compliance needs, working with business users, QA, IT teams and vendors.
highlights: Coordinate user and license management, including setup, deactivation, roles, profiles and permission access, for 300+ users
Configure workflows, custom fields, page layouts, record types, dashboards and reports, improving operational efficiency by 30%
Troubleshoot system issues, configuration errors and access problems, reducing CRM-related incidents by 35%
Partner with business users to gather requirements and design CRM solutions aligned with banking operations
Work with QA teams to validate fixes and support UAT cycles, and assist with sprint planning and JIRA tracking

roles.title: Salesforce CRM Administrator
roles.description: I administered and enhanced enterprise CRM platforms for financial and enterprise clients.
highlights: Configured workflows, business rules, forms, views, dashboards and reports, increasing user adoption by 25%
Supported data migration and cleansing activities, achieving 98% data accuracy
Provided hands-on troubleshooting and root cause analysis for system and data issues
Designed and supported custom CRM solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements
Participated in Agile/Scrum delivery, supporting sprint reviews, testing and documentation
